name: fuel_injection_ci_engine
title: Fuel injection in an atmospheric compression-ignition engine
summary: Teaching exercise: a 5-cylinder naturally aspirated diesel engine captures a given air mass per cycle; the fuel mass follows from an equivalence ratio with C12H26, and the injector outlet area and diameter from the incompressible orifice equation over the injection window.

origin.course: ULiège MCI, TP6, exercise 3 (after Pulkrabek, Engineering Fundamentals of the Internal Combustion Engine, problems 5-9 and 5-10)
